short_name: On the foundations of Earth foundation models
evidence_note: Supplies the capability-profile and feature-matrix grammar and identifies diversity, representative tasks, component interaction and physical consistency as benchmark requirements.

short_name: No One Knows the State of the Art in Geospatial Foundation Models
evidence_note: Documents incompatible protocols, unreleased weights and missing controls; motivates variance reporting, shared evaluation harnesses and data-versus-architecture controls.

placement_decision: Benchmark section and embedding-specific control box
evidence_note: Distinguishes implicit, patch and pixel products and shows that temporal support, pooling, transfer, licensing and reproducibility must be benchmarked at the product level.

short_name: A harmonised dataset for Earth system foundation models
placement_decision: Bridge from benchmark section to Prospects
evidence_note: WorldTensor is explicitly infrastructure rather than a model benchmark; its annual 0.25-degree support enables planetary interannual tests but is unsuitable for event-scale ecohydrological validation without finer and more direct observations.
